Nationwide 'Har Ghar Tiranga' Campaign Celebrates National Flag

Across India, a 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign encouraged citizens to display the national flag. Prime Minister Modi called on every household to participate. Numerous rallies, including bike rallies and 'Tiranga Yatras', were held in various locations such as Delhi, Kashmir, Bastar, and Indore. Officials, including Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Adityanath and Jammu and Kashmir Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha, highlighted the campaign's significance as a tribute to freedom fighters' sacrifices and a symbol of national pride and unity. The campaign also saw participation from Union Ministers and Vice-President Radhakrishnan.
